name: Invoke LLM
description: Send the current message context and available tool schemas to the configured LLM endpoint. Returns the raw model response including any tool-call blocks.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Ordered list of messages forming the current conversation context

inputs.name: tool_schemas
inputs.description: JSON Schema definitions for tools the model may call

inputs.name: persona_ref
inputs.description: Reference to a persona atom that sets the system prompt

outputs.name: tool_calls
outputs.description: Extracted tool-call blocks from the response (may be empty)

outputs.name: final_message
outputs.description: Text content of the assistant turn (populated when no tool calls present)
